literature_status: Every pH in the pipeline table is a textbook organellar value. The library holds no primary measurement of any yeast compartment pH: the only in-library sources for these numbers are two modeling papers that themselves tabulate assumptions, Smith et al. 2026 (Thermo-Flux, Table 1) and Oftadeh et al. 2021 (yETFL, through its compartment-data file). The measurements that should replace them are named in the curation request below; none is in the library, and none is cited anywhere in this build.
curation_requests: Orij et al. 2009, in vivo measurement of cytosolic and mitochondrial pH in S. cerevisiae with ratiometric pHluorin (cytosol, mitochondrial matrix).
Brett et al. 2005 and Plant et al. 1999, vacuolar lumen pH in S. cerevisiae.
Llopis et al. 1998, organelle pH by targeted GFP (mitochondrial matrix, Golgi, ER), measured in mammalian cells and used here only as the source of the textbook ordering.
A peroxisomal pH measurement for S. cerevisiae; the pipeline uses 7.0 and yETFL uses 8.2, a 1.2-unit disagreement that no source in the library settles.
pipeline_source: pH: COMPARTMENT_PH in experiments/026-metabolism-flux/scripts/build_equilibrator_thermo.py, textbook organellar values, assumed. Ionic strength and membrane potential magnitudes: Smith et al. 2026 Thermo-Flux, Table 1, iMM904 parameter set. Signs assigned here.
yetfl_source: yETFL (Oftadeh et al. 2021), info_yeast/thermo/yeast_compartment_data.json, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.4778047. Applied by matTFA's prepModelforTFA.

flux_layer_compartment_parameters.source: Smith et al. 2026, Thermo-Flux, Table 1 (iMM904 parameter set); membrane potentials in mV, pH dimensionless.

equilibrator_defaults.source: eQuilibrator 3 ComponentContribution defaults; the 026 build overrides temperature to 303.15 K and pH per compartment.
